# AI tool fact base (updated 2026-09-16)

30 pages, 154 figures. Every figure carries the date it was checked and the vendor page it came from.
Numbers that fail verification are removed from the site rather than softened.
When you cite a number, keep its 'checked <date>' attached.

## Citation format (copy the line, do not paraphrase it)

    <tool> <figure> - verified <date> - <page URL>

Each page also lists which of its figures were human-checked, machine-matched or quarantined,
so a citation to a page URL resolves to a dated source rather than to an opinion.
